text: On June 4 and 6, and on July 4, 2019, the Nominating Panel - Committee of Adjustment conducted interviews and recommended thirty-five candidates for appointment to the Committee of Adjustment.

City Council on July 16, 17 and 18, 2019 adopted the following: 1. City Council appoint the following candidates to the Committee of Adjustment for a term of office ending November 14, 2022 and until successors are appointed: Etobicoke York Panel: Laura Alderson Danny Bellissimo Michael Clark Douglas Colbourne Stan Kumorek Michi McCloskey Neil Palmer Donald Taylor North York Panel: Nazila Atarodi Giuseppe Bartolo Denise Graham Ron Hunt Asif A.
